sources.citation: Pre-insulated ring, fork and butt terminals are colour-coded across makers (typical published figures, paraphrased, not one vendor's): red for 22-18 AWG (some makers mark red 22-16), blue for 16-14 AWG and yellow for 12-10 AWG, and ratcheting crimpers of this class carry matching coloured die nests. The die ids are the colours (stable save format); crimp connectors are listed to UL 486A-B (cited by number only).
game-design: the crimp capability reaches the largest die, 10 AWG.
